checks.evidence: README and DEPLOYMENT explicitly exclude production marketplace, Express onboarding, payouts, persistent ledger, tenant identity, reconciliation, billing, permissions, and emails.

Signed HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite cookie; exact Origin and JSON checks on mutating endpoints; checkout/refund/payment ownership checks at api/index.py:35-63, 104-141, 148-160. Hosted evidence records foreign-cookie access as 403.
services.py:37-55 accepts only test Stripe keys and acct_ destinations; webhook rejects livemode events at api/index.py:165-177. No credentials found in scoped source/evidence.

Checkout/refund keys are UUID-validated and session-scoped; Stripe receives idempotency keys at services.py:83-106. Hosted evidence proves 30 EUR replay returned the same refund ID without duplication. Distinct concurrent keys are delegated to Stripe's refund source of truth.
Node tests pass. Pytest could not start because this environment's /tmp is not writable and pytest cannot create its capture tempfile; parent-supplied evidence states 9 pytest tests pass.

findings.reproduction: Deploy a clean checkout of git HEAD from demos/partner-payments-stripe using its vercel.json.
findings.root_cause: The Vercel manifest builds public/**, but no public/ directory exists in git HEAD; the frontend is a separate sibling directory. README line 9 and DEPLOYMENT.md line 27 require an undocumented external staging/package step.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the candidate self-contained: include the frontend under public/ or change the deployment root/build configuration to package demos/partner-payments deterministically.

findings.reproduction: Deliver two valid signed test webhook events for the same PaymentIntent with different event IDs, then replay the older event.
findings.root_cause: Every accepted event calls mark_verified and overwrites demo_verified_event_id; there is no event-ID deduplication or monotonic protection. Replay has no financial effect but can make the displayed verification evidence stale.
findings.suggested_fix: Ignore already-seen event IDs and only set the verification marker when the existing marker is absent, or preserve an auditable event set.
